Respect for gate queues
Early winter has been kind to the desk
Quiet paws, smooth plans

The Companion Animal Travel Desk has kept a steady rhythm this week, with staff smoothing last-minute changes and helping travelers stay calm at the counter. Pet papers, cabin checks, and handoff notes all moved along with the same easy focus that keeps Aurelia Skyways running well between skyports.

When a case needed extra review, the team followed the usual calm stepwise path and kept everyone informed without fuss. That steady approach is making the desk feel dependable, and travelers are noticing the difference.
